name: ÅLHULT across the room, bench on the top wall, BESTÅ sideboard on the bottom wall
notes:
Bench against the top wall: the ÅLHULT (ash veneer) turned across the room with its matching bench, which needs no pull-out room, so the table sits against it and the bottom half of the room stays open; the BESTÅ sideboard takes the bottom wall. Set for six as placed with the table closed: the bench (2), three SANDSBERG and Maddie's URBAN. Nothing stands in the 30" walkway (F-42).
Flags: tight:32.3 (F-36, the table's right end to the right wall; Maddie's URBAN takes that end, since a parent pushes her in and she never needs an adult's 36"); assumed-position:door; anchor-required (storage-1, F-21).
table-1 ÅLHULT extendable, beige/brown (ikea-60597921), rot 0 at x 48.5, y 14.125, closed 47 1/4 x 31 1/2" along the 128" width: F-36 48.5" from its left end to the kitchen line (passing, met), 56.9" from its open side to the sideboard (passing, met), 32.25" from its right end to the right wall (tight:32.3). The leaf stays out here: opened in place (66 7/8") the right end would come within 12.6" of the wall.
bench-1 ÅLHULT bench (ikea-60603093), top wall, centered under the table: two seats with the wall behind them (F-36's 36" is for chairs; a bench backed to a wall needs none).

junior-chair-1 URBAN (ikea-00165213), right end: 13.4" behind it (the tight:32.3 end).
storage-1 BESTÅ storage combination with drawers, white stained oak effect (ikea-39412689), bottom wall centered on the table (x 36.7 to 107.6): F-32 38.4" from the drawer fronts to the seated chairs' backs (36" preferred, met), 56.9" to the table; push-open drawers and doors, no knobs; anchor-required (F-21: 29 1/8").
art-1 BLODFLÄDER (ikea-20601915), top layer, right wall centered on the table's long axis (y 6.25 to 53.5): seen down the length of the table from the kitchen, above Maddie's seat.

pendant-1 GULLSUDARE (ikea-90603869), top layer over the table's center (72.1, 29.9) on the HAVSRIS swag cord: 8" right of and 30" above the room's center, so the hook, not a center box, places it.

Extras: HAVSRIS x 1; STOPP FILT x 2; SVARTSENAP runner x 1; placemats x 6; BLANDA MATT bowl x 1. No chair pads: the MALINDA overhangs the SANDSBERG seat by 1 5/8".
Not placed: a fourth SANDSBERG (bench 2 + 3 chairs + URBAN = 6). No window is drawn, so no window treatments (F-41). The kitchen line is unmeasured (wall, counter or open floor): the clearances treat it as the edge of a 30" walkway that stays clear (F-42).
